item.title: Nvidia’s stock is giving back more than half of Monday’s rally as dip buyers cash in
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Based on where retail investors bought Nvidia’s stock on the dip last week, their gains are nearly all gone, according to Vanda Research.

item.title: Inflation gets worse. Now the Fed no choice but to raise U.S. interest rates.
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: The measure of inflation used by the Federal Reserve to influence U.S. interest rates rose again in October at an accelerated rate, virtually assuring the central bank will increase borrowing costs next month.
